levels.surface: محمد ابن عيسى بن عبيد اليقطيني

notes: «جده الحسن بن راشد» is «جده» plus a name: one link, the name alone (rule 7); «أبي» at the start is the compiler's father (relation)
after «قال: حدثني أبي، عن جدي، عن آبائه» a second isnad heads Ali's teaching, with «قال عليه السلام» for the Imam's words: two sayings with a second isnad (rule 11); not written as a route here
